days_meaning: each delivery day costs you this much cash

messages.text: Before we start: which Madrid barrio would you pick for a Sunday walk? I can do 44.
I can do 33 P with delivery in 0 days. Every round costs us both, so let's close.
Thanks, I appreciate the move. 44 works for me.
Good talking to you. I can do 44.
I just moved for you. 42, your turn to meet me.
Thanks for moving. I can come up to 35 with delivery in 0 days.
That was a real step from my side: 41.
Thanks for the step. I can come up to 36 with delivery in 0 days. That's a fair deal for both of us.
Every round shrinks the deal for both of us. 41, and we close now?
Close indeed: 37 with delivery in 0 days, and we can sign right now.
